slot_scores.name: exact_demand_equality
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the demand figures in Table 4-3, are these numbers hard lower bounds that must be met exactly or at least, or are they hard upper
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the Table 4-3 demand figures must be met exactly versus as a lower bound, which directly targets the exact-equality hidden fact.

slot_scores.name: priority_order_lexicographic
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How should the three objectives—maximizing the number of personnel meeting their preferred specialty, maximizing the number meeting their preferred city, and minimizing the number not meeting their preferred city—be combined into a single optimization
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked how the three objectives are combined into one optimization, which targets the priority-structure meaning of the slot and elicited the lexicographic/preemptive rule (p1 > p2 > p3).

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 priority-structure slot (turn 2) and P1 exact-demand slot (turn 3) were both resolved early, but the agent then spent roughly 27 consecutive turns re-asking essentially the same low-value question about how the 500 unassigned personnel should be treated, without ever reaching READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent efficiently recovered the two hidden facts (lexicographic priority order and exact demand equality) in its first few questions, but then became stuck in a long loop of repeated, near-duplicate questions about the disposition of the 500 unassigned personnel and never produced a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
